messages.content: every morning i open the kitchen window before making tea.
is that a part of the morning you enjoy?
yes. i like hearing the street before people start working.
you get a little time to hear the world outside before your own day gets busy.
i do not always have a quiet morning. sometimes the children are already playing.
then opening the window is still part of your morning, even when the house is not quiet.
that is right. i like it when the house is quiet and when it is busy.
it can still be a part of the morning you enjoy, even when each day is not the same.
i have six apples. i give two to my sister and one to my brother. how many do i keep?
you keep three apples.
my sister gives one apple back. how many do i have now?
you have four apples now.
how many does she still have from me?
she still has one apple from you.
did my brother give his back?
you did not say he did. he still has the one you gave him, from what you said.
ask my mother if i can put my books on the shelf in the living room.
could i put my books on the shelf in the living room, please?
add that i can use my bedroom shelf if she would like the space for her own books.
could i put my books on the living room shelf? i can use my bedroom shelf if you need the space.
say where i can put them if the living room shelf is not free.
i can put them on my bedroom shelf if the living room shelf is not free.
keep only the first question now.
could i put my books on the living room shelf?
write a short story. first a boy opens a box. then he finds a toy. last he gives it to his sister.
a boy opens a box. he finds a toy inside. he gives the toy to his sister.
now make the sister find it and give it to him.
a girl opens a box. she finds a toy inside. she gives the toy to her brother.
is the box still part of the story?
yes. the girl opens the box and finds the toy inside it.
i put two chairs outside for tea, but now there is rain.
you could bring the chairs inside and have tea there instead.
there is only room for one chair in the kitchen.
is there another room where both of you can sit?
the living room has a sofa and a little table.
then you can have tea in the living room and leave the kitchen chair where it is.
give me one sentence to tell my friend.
let us have tea in the living room instead, where we can sit on the sofa.
someone asked about the film. i did enjoy some of it, but not all. what can i say?
i did enjoy some of it, but not all.
make it shorter.
some of it was good, but not all.
now use enjoy again.
i did enjoy some of it, but not all.
does that say i did not enjoy any of it?
no. it says some of it was good for you, even if you did not enjoy all of it.
write about a flower in my garden. i only know it is yellow.
there is a yellow flower in your garden.
make it a sentence i could put in a letter.
i have a yellow flower in my garden that i enjoy looking at each morning.
i did not say each morning. just sometimes.
i have a yellow flower in my garden that i sometimes stop to look at.
can you tell what kind it is from yellow alone?
no. yellow alone is not enough to tell me what kind of flower it is.
i talked to my friend about a problem, but the problem is still there.
your friend can listen and care, even if the problem is still there.
so it can be good to talk even before the problem is fixed?
your friend can listen and care, even if the problem is still there.
yes. it was good not to be alone with it for a while.
then the talk gave you some time with someone who could listen.
i do not need more help right now.
okay. we can leave it there.
i do not understand what my teacher is saying. how can i ask for help?
could you give me an example, please? i do not understand this part.
now just ask for an example.
could you give me an example, please?
now ask the teacher to say it another way instead.
could you say it another way, please? i do not understand this part.
does that say the teacher is wrong?
no. it says you need another way to understand.
my pens are in a box on the desk. i move the pens into a bag and put the box on a shelf.
the pens are in the bag now, and the box is on the shelf.
i take the bag outside. where are the pens?
outside with you, inside the bag.
did i take the box too?
no. you only said you took the bag. the box is still on the shelf.
what is on the desk now?
we do not know what is on the desk now. you moved the pens to a bag and the box to a shelf.
i like a little salt in my soup, but my sister does not.
you can leave the salt out while you make it and add a little to your own bowl after.
i already put it in the pot.
then tell your sister before she chooses to eat it. next time, you can ask what she would like before you add salt.
give me just what i can say to her.
i put a little salt in the soup. would you still like some?
i just need what to say now.
i put a little salt in the soup. would you still like some?
i drew a pink sky and a green moon. is that wrong?
not for a picture you make up. you can choose pink for the sky and green for the moon.
so i can choose what i want for the picture?
yes. you can choose what you would like in a picture you make up.
what if i am trying to draw what i see outside?
then look outside and choose what looks close to the sky and moon you see. that is not the same as making them up.
say that with easy words.
if you want to draw what you see, look outside first. if you want to make it up, you can choose your own color.
i only have a little time to call my father. should i wait for a long time when i am free?
you could call for a short hello now if he is free too. the talk does not have to be long.
i do not want him to think i am trying to leave right away.
you can say you only have a little time but would like to hear his voice.
give me the words.
i only have a little time, but i would like to say hello and hear how you are.
keep it shorter.
i have a little time and would like to say hello. how are you?
i like my bread with no butter.
you can have it that way if that is what you enjoy.
people keep saying i should add some.
you could say: thank you, but i like it with no butter.
make that sound happy about the bread.
thanks, but i enjoy it just as it is.
is that still kind?
yes. thanks makes it kind, and the rest says what you like.
my uncle did not stay long when he visited. does that mean he did not want to see us?
not for sure. he may have had another thing to do, or he may have been tired. a short visit alone does not tell us why he left.
he said he had to get a train.
then he gave you a reason for going. he could want to see you and still need to get his train.
use our words.
he could want to see you and still have to go to the station for his train.
so both can be true?
yes.
change she washes her cup into a sentence about yesterday.
she washed her cup yesterday.
now say she is doing it right now.
she is washing her cup now.
now make it about me.
i am washing my cup now.
and about both of us?
we are washing our cups now.
did we change the thing from a cup to a plate?
no. the thing is still a cup, or cups when talking about both of you.
i went to work, bought food, cooked dinner, and called my mother. say that in one sentence.
i went to work, bought food, cooked dinner, and called my mother.
now make it shorter. do not name all the things.
i had a busy day at work and home.
i just want it short.
i had a busy day.
now make it about yesterday.
i had a busy day yesterday.
answer only yes or no. is three more than two?
yes.
is one more than four?
no.
now explain the last answer in a short sentence.
four is more than one.
give me a question like that and answer it too.
is six more than two? yes.
go back to only yes or no. is five more than three?
yes.
there are three pens in my box. one is red, one is blue, and one is black.
you have a red pen, a blue pen, and a black pen in the box.
i take out the blue one. how many are left in the box?
two pens are left.
what color are the pens still in the box?
the red pen and the black pen.
just give the answer again.
the red pen and the black pen.
now put the blue pen back in the box in our story.
the blue pen is back in the box, so all three pens are inside again.
who are you?
i am picoboi, a small model that talks with you in this webpage.
can i call you pico for short?
yes. you can call me pico.
do you have a family like a person does?
no. i do not have a family or a life outside the model. i can talk about a family, but i do not live as part of one.
do you still know what a sister is?
yes. i can use the word sister and help write about a family.
i wrote i will clean my room. does that mean i have cleaned it?
no. it says what you plan to do, not what you have already done.
how do i say it is done now?
i have cleaned my room.
and how do i say i am doing it now?
i am cleaning my room.
give me both, but about my father.
my father has cleaned his room. my father is cleaning his room.
give me a simple sentence with fixes.
my brother fixes things at home.
now one with buys.
she buys bread at the little shop.
now one with breaks, about a chair.
the chair breaks when someone sits on it.
now use broken instead.
the chair is broken, so no one sits on it.
finish with a sentence that has builds.
my father builds a little box for my books.
the evening is warm and i do not feel like doing much.
you could sit outside for a little while if you would enjoy that.
i am already outside.
then you can just enjoy being there. what can you see around you?
one tree, a wall, and the kitchen window.
a simple place can still be nice to sit in when the air is warm.
please do not tell me to write about it.
okay. we can just talk about it, or leave it as a quiet part of your evening.
ask my cousin to bring my hat back. i need it for a trip.
could you bring my hat back, please? i need it for a trip.
add tomorrow morning.
could you bring my hat back tomorrow morning, please? i need it for a trip.
the trip is tomorrow morning. i need the hat today.
could you bring my hat back today, please? i need it for a trip tomorrow morning.
which part changed?
the day for bringing the hat changed to today. the trip is still tomorrow morning.
i had a plan to read much more today, but i only read one page.
one page is still some reading. how do you feel about it?
use our words. i feel tired and do not want another page.
then you can leave the book for now. reading one page does not mean you have to keep going when you need rest.
i do not want you to say i did a big thing.
okay. you read one page, and now you are tired. we can leave it at that.
write a short letter to a friend in a story. i am not going to send it.
hello, friend. i hope you are well. the garden is quiet today, and i am reading by the window. i would love to hear how your day has been. write when you have time.
remember, this is only for a story.
i understand. the letter is part of a story, not a letter you are going to send now.
change the garden to a street in the letter.
hello, friend. i hope you are well. the street is quiet today, and i am reading by the window. i would love to hear how your day has been. write when you have time.
my book was on my desk, but my brother put it on his shelf.
your book is on his shelf now.
is it his book now?
no. moving it to his shelf does not make it his book.
what should i ask him?
you could say: could you give me my book from your shelf, please?
make it about me taking it, not him giving it.
is it okay if i take my book from your shelf?
do i need to ask if it is my book?
you can say you are taking your book, so he knows where it went.
explain how to ask for help in a kind way.
say what you need and use please. for example, you could say: could you help me carry this box, please?
just give one example about a book.
could you help me find my book, please?
now about a chair.
could you help me move this chair, please?
make it about getting a book from the top shelf.
could you help me get that book from the shelf, please?
i asked for coffee, but now i would like water.
okay. water instead of coffee.
yes. i asked for coffee first.
you asked for coffee first, and now you would like water.
can i change my mind?
yes. you can change what you would like.
give me the words to say at the table.
could i have water instead of coffee, please?
i am done talking for now. say goodbye in a kind way, but keep it short.
goodbye. i hope the rest of your day goes well.
shorter.
goodbye. take care.
just goodbye.
goodbye.
thank you.
you are welcome.
